text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh~ That lipstick is the one Mar-chan 
gave you...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I totally fell in love with the 
vanilla lip balm you gave me for my 
birthday, so I've been using it all the 
time♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was a perfect fit. Its 
moisturizing power keeps lips plump and 
glossy. And on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I figured the scent would pair 
wonderfully with Flight-san's hair oil as 
well. ...I chose vanilla with a lot of 
thought, you know."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Orange hair oil with vanilla! Those 
two scents really might blend together 
nicely!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even I wouldn't have thought of such a 
great combination...! You're amazing, 
Mar-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Naturally. I am being taught every 
day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Always showing me how you pick outfit 
colors right in front of me. Showing me 
your makeup and hairstyles, too...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because Mar-chan has a wonderful fashion 
guru. Mar-chan has become a fashion leader 
too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah... hehe, that's right! Chan-me is a 
full-fledged fashion maven too!
